blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) will provide financial and medical assistance, including the repatriation of seven Filipino workers injured in attacks attributed to Houthi forces in Saudi Arabia. In a Radyo Pilipinas interview, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac assured government assistance to the affected overseas Filipino workers (OFWs), especially those […]...
